title: Couplings Farthest from the Independent Gaussian
summary: Motivated by Wasserstein measures of dependence, we study the largest possible 2-Wasserstein distance between a joint distribution and the product of its prescribed marginals. For two uniform marginals, Catalano and Lavenant conjectured that the monotone and antimonotone couplings maximize the distance from the independent coupling. We prove the Gaussian analogue for an arbitrary number $n\geq 2$ of one-dimensional standard Gaussian marginals.
